item.title: On The Outside, Looking In
item.description: Through his imaginative work as an “outsider artist,” James Castle, deaf from birth, managed to leave behind rare observations—some hidden for years from view—made inside his quiet world The post On The Outside, Looking In appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: Hold The Line
item.description: Architect Jeremy Corkern designs houses for people today, but he often relies on an age-old technique—drawing on paper—when conceiving his plans The post Hold The Line appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: Connecticut Calm
item.description: For those seeking a refined countryside getaway, the Mayflower Inn & Spa offers a variety of activities, even as the seasons shift. In winter, guests enjoy festive décor, scenic winter walks, and fireside s’mores under the stars. The post Connecticut Calm appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: Alpine By Design
item.description: A riverside cottage in Colorado’s Vail Valley, built in 1989 by a master woodworker from Austria, has been carefully renovated to retain its European charm and craftsmanship The post Alpine By Design appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: Out Of Town
item.description: An architecture-minded couple wanted a retreat from Manhattan, but away from the familiar weekend destinations. They landed in a small Pennsylvania village. The post Out Of Town appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: The Belle Of Belle Meade
item.description: A home in one of Nashville’s historic communities has become a contemporary example of traditional design, inside and out The post The Belle Of Belle Meade appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: Celebrating Everyday Life
item.description: Emma Sims-Hilditch declares right away in this (second) book about her interior designs something so refreshing and affirming about the discipline in which she has become a star. Of herself and her team, as they work from their Cotswolds and London offices. The post Celebrating Everyday Life appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: The Healing Home
item.description: We all think of our homes as sacred spaces. But the designer Carley Summers chronicles 14 houses where the actual rooms and spaces work to heal their occupants. The post The Healing Home appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: The Art of Interior Design
item.description: With two books already to their credit, Julie Goebel and daughter Caitlin Flemming decided that it was time to write a third—and the result is what could easily become an indispensable resource for beginners, as well as more seasoned individuals, with an interest in perfecting—and understanding more fully—the art of interior design. The post The Art of Interior Design appeared first on Milieu Magazine.

item.title: French Finds
item.description: Francophile extraordinaire Sharon Santoni, founder of My French Country Home, a popular magazine and a lifestyle brand that have become synonymous with an appreciation for the finer aspects of living in France, brings her formidable knowledge of le style de vie française to the pages of a new book devoted to the world of French antiques and pre-loved “treasures” of lesser value—where to find them and how to make them your own. The post French Finds appeared first on Milieu Magazine.
